qa_pairs.question: Which engine types use M70/S70/M73 cylinder head bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Engine type 7AZ uses M70/S70/M73 cylinder head bolts

qa_pairs.question: What important note is given about cylinder head screws for repair work?
qa_pairs.answer: For repair work, only use screws with Torx head

qa_pairs.question: What instruction is given about the coating on cylinder head screws?
qa_pairs.answer: Do not wash away coating on cylinder head screws
